entries.title: Kenshi

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Kenshi is sourced as a Windows PC game; the native PC release is the only documented platform route and is therefore the highest-fidelity, most complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Kenshi on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and use the current patched release; Steam is especially convenient if you want Workshop mod support.

entries.remaster_caveats: Kenshi 2 has been announced but has no sourced release date or playable release to archive as a separate entry yet.
